name: starts empty
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
assert tree.contains(10) is False
assert tree.in_order() == []

name: inserts and finds values
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for value in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4]:
    tree.insert(value)
assert tree.contains(4) is True
assert tree.contains(6) is False

name: returns in-order values
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for value in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4, 6, 8]:
    tree.insert(value)
assert tree.in_order() == [1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

name: keeps duplicates
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for value in [5, 3, 5, 3]:
    tree.insert(value)
assert tree.in_order() == [3, 3, 5, 5]
